name: AXL receptor tyrosine kinase
pathways: positive regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction

function.text: AXL encodes tyrosine-protein kinase receptor UFO. Annotated molecular activities include protein tyrosine kinase activity and transmembrane receptor protein tyrosine kinase activity. It participates in signal transduction and positive regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction.
